questions.question: Why is unitless line-height (e.g., line-height: 1.6) recommended over pixel values (e.g., line-height: 24px)?
options: Unitless line-height acts as a proportional multiplier that scales with font-size changes in child elements
Pixel line-height is blocked by ad-blockers
questions.hint: It scales proportionally with font size.
questions.explanation: A unitless line-height (e.g. 1.6) scales proportionally with any element's font-size, preventing text collision bugs.

questions.question: What is the purpose of font-display: swap in an @font-face rule?
options: To swap fonts randomly on reload
To prevent Flash of Invisible Text (FOIT) by rendering fallback fonts until custom fonts load
questions.hint: Swaps fallback font with custom font.
questions.explanation: font-display: swap renders fallback system fonts immediately while downloading custom fonts, eliminating FOIT.

questions.question: Which generic font family has clean letterforms without decorative feet/serifs at the ends of strokes?
questions.explanation: Sans-serif typefaces (like Arial, Inter, Roboto) lack decorative feet (serifs) and provide modern, clean readability.

questions.question: Which property adjusts the spacing between individual characters in words?
questions.explanation: letter-spacing (or tracking) increases or decreases the space between characters in text.

questions.question: Which property automatically transforms text to all capital letters without modifying HTML source?
questions.explanation: text-transform: uppercase renders all characters in uppercase while leaving the underlying HTML content unchanged.
